title: How to master handling technical jargon on your Mac for consistent documentation
metaTitle: Handling technical jargon: A guide for Mac technical writers
description: Learn how to improve terminology management and master handling technical jargon in your technical documentation on macOS.
intro: Handling technical jargon effectively is the foundation of clear, accurate documentation. Without a solid process, terminology drifts and confuses your readers.
tldr: Terminology management is the DNA of your documentation.
Inconsistent terms cause support costs to rise.
Use a central termbase to stop terminology drift.
Automate validation to catch errors as you write.
Lazur helps you keep your terminology list close.

stats.label: of content can become unusable without proper documentation operations

blocks.text: Terminology management is the systematic collection and maintenance of standardized product terms. It ensures that every team member uses the same language. When you fail at handling technical jargon, your documentation suffers from term drift. This drift makes your content harder to read and translate.
The hidden costs of inconsistent terminology

Inconsistency is expensive. When you use three names for one port, your users get confused. This leads to more tickets for your support team. It also increases the time translators spend asking for clarifications. In regulated fields, it can even create legal liability.

items: Lack of a central authority for term approval.
Engineering and marketing using different names for the same component.
Manual tracking in static spreadsheets that quickly become outdated.
Reliance on AI tools that do not enforce your specific style guide.

blocks.text: You do not need expensive software to start. Begin by creating a shared glossary. Use a tool that integrates with your editor. If you use Markdown, keep your terms in a separate file. This allows you to update a term in one place and see it propagate through your docs.
If you work in a regulated industry, always follow your employer's specific rules on client or patient data. Never put sensitive data into unauthorized third-party tools.
blocks.title: Stay compliant

blocks.text: How to use Lazur for terminology

Lazur helps you keep your terminology list accessible while you write. You can ask Lazur to remind you of the approved term for a specific component. It answers out loud, so you do not need to switch windows.

Choose tools that support structured content. Apps like adoc Studio help with AsciiDoc files. These allow for easier version control of your termbase via Git. If you use a CMS, look for built-in authoring assistance that flags non-approved terms.

faq.question: How do I start a termbase?
faq.answer: Start by listing the 20 most confusing terms in your current project. Get consensus from your subject matter experts.

faq.question: Can AI help with terminology?
faq.answer: AI can help you find inconsistencies, but it often struggles to enforce specific, pre-approved terms without a strict prompt.
